compute_numerical_statistics: compute min, max, mean, median, std and histogram for a numerical column in a polars DataFrame
compute_categorical_statistics: compute value counts and frequencies for a class label column using the ClassLabelColumn class
compute_histogram: compute a histogram with bin edges for float or int column data using polars
compute_audio_video_statistics: compute duration statistics for audio or video columns by reading parquet files and decoding media
compute_datetime_statistics: compute min, max, mean, median, std and histogram for datetime columns by converting to timedelta seconds
